date_policy.start_selection: New future UTC-midnight start after engineering review, official source/fee/rate verification, independent acceptance and explicit study approval; no backfill
date_policy.release_rule: At least two days after collection end, with fresh official settlement rechecks and all outcomes resolved; never automatic date shifts

frozen_design.primary_strategy_selection: Proposed before collection; no selection based on study002 outcomes. A changed primary needs a separately reviewed protocol before any new data is collected.

acceptance.stress_daily_lower_bound: strictly > 0 for all predeclared block lengths
acceptance.paired_zero_minus_market_brier_upper_bou: strictly < 0 for all predeclared block lengths

cost_policy.stress_scenario: Preserve current conservative fragmentation bounds and predeclared slippage reserves. No weakening after results.
cost_policy.required_evidence: Independent official current KXBTC15M fee/multiplier, fill quantum, account precision and applicable read cost/rate verification; no account mutations or authenticated test launch in this proposal

persistence_policy.confirmation: Only previously completed observation with matching digest, logged state and committed completion marker, healthy source provenance and a newer source sample may confirm
persistence_policy.authorities: Study database transactions and unique slot/signal keys; observation JSONL diagnostic only
persistence_policy.duplicate_policy: Exact repeated state observation idempotent; conflicting same-time payload/reversed clock rejected; study clock read/check/write serialized
persistence_policy.crash_policy: Any uncommitted new observation stays nonconfirming across restart. Gaps/missing execution windows are retained, not backfilled or imputed. Pending diagnostics may duplicate after crash; never substitute them for authoritative outcomes.
persistence_policy.remaining_gate: Demonstrate separately reviewed machine power-loss, reboot/clock continuity, retention/disk-capacity and interrupted-publication recovery policy before activation

holdout_policy.result_access: Separate evaluator and access controls; no analyst holdout queries before approved release

approval_gates: All engineering blockers addressed or explicitly reviewed with bounded operating scope
Successful independent acceptance review; Reasonix timeout/partial output is not sign-off
New source/protocol/dependency and configuration hashes archived together
Separate manifest-bound evidence-only approval before proposed start
No approval inheritance or modification of study002 sealed release
Prepare a separately reviewed research release; do not remove the offline candidate guard as an adoption shortcut
